subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers treat the 2026-07-05 live session and journal evidence as enough to queue a focused repair, or require raw logs/a maintainer-run current-main repro first?
rationale: The report now has strong same-release live evidence, but the root cause is not isolated enough for a safe autonomous fix against one file or subsystem.

options.title: Request raw logs and maintainer replay
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for the promised raw journal/session logs or a maintainer live replay before assigning a repair path.

options.title: Queue focused investigation now
options.body: Promote a repair job limited to reproducing and instrumenting restart/compaction/tool-output paths, stopping before product-surface changes.

options.title: Split compaction delay separately
options.body: Keep this issue for blank tool bodies and open a separate linked item for the sessions.compact startup latency if maintainers want separate ownership.

recommendation.title: Request raw logs and maintainer replay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for the promised raw journal/session logs or a maintainer live replay before assigning a repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to the release/current gateway reload and session-lock surfaces most central to the new evidence.
